items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I heard him on record and, if I'm not mistaken, I saw him with Count Basie... And when I met him -- when I first met him, it was a real thrill to me

ctx.x: Okay. Now, were there any people in that band who later became well known players, in this Peanuts Holland band?
Not that I -- I don't quite remember. I know Peanuts, that years later he played with Count Basie and what have you. But as far as the other members, the saxophone
x no. Charlie Barnet, Don Redman. Cob Collogay's small band
